# AUT spec → test traceability (Step 7 review of PR #11)

Repo `main` = `83027e5` (branch `linh/aut-verify`). Read-only analysis; no test was run for this map.
Spec: `docs/spec/specs/spec-AUT.md` §3 (lines 83–240) and §5.2 (lines 415–434). Scenarios have no IDs in the
spec, so they are labelled `US-n AS-k` in order of appearance; edge cases `EC-k`.

Status rule (strict): COVERED = a test asserts the behaviour. PARTIAL = some part untested; "svc-only" means
the behaviour is asserted only by calling `src/lib/auth/*` directly, never through the `src/app/api/*` route.
MISSING = no test asserts it.

## 3. Counts

57 rows: 16 BR + 29 US acceptance scenarios + 8 edge cases + 4 consistency examples.
- COVERED: 14 — BR-007, BR-011, BR-013, BR-014, US-2 AS-1, US-3 AS-2, US-7 AS-2, US-8 AS-3, US-9 AS-2,
  EC-5, EC-6, EC-8, AC-AUT-OTP, AC-AUT-SESSION.
- MISSING: 7 — BR-001, BR-004, US-1 AS-3, US-2 AS-3, US-5 AS-2, US-6 AS-3, EC-7.
- PARTIAL: 36 — every other row. 9 of them are PARTIAL only because they are svc-only (BR-002, BR-005,
  BR-006, US-1 AS-1, US-4 AS-1, US-6 AS-1, US-7 AS-1, US-8 AS-2, US-10 AS-2); the other 27 have a
  behavioural gap.

Note on the "svc-only" level: only `POST /api/auth/login`, `GET /api/auth/session`, `POST /api/auth/logout`
are exercised on a success path. `/api/register*`, `/api/auth/forgot-password`, `/change-password`,
`/users/create`, `/api/register/resubmit` are hit only on refusal paths (401/403/400/503);
`/api/auth/agency-reviews` POST, `/api/auth/users` GET/PATCH, `/api/auth/reset-password` and
`/api/register/verify-otp` are never called by any test.

## 4. Separate findings

### (a) BRs whose code could not be found
None is entirely absent. Two are only partly implemented:
- BR-012: no five-minute mechanism (see c).
- BR-001: enforced by construction (registration hard-codes `Tour_Agency`, `registration-service.ts:62`); there
  is no explicit guard or test.

### (b) Test names citing BR/AS IDs
- No AUT test (RF, LC, LA, PL, RA, AA, AR, AS, PS, RV, `tests/contract/auth-session-api.test.ts`,
  `tests/unit/auth-session-context.test.ts`, `tests/unit/password-cost.test.ts`) cites any BR, AS or AC ID.
- `tests/unit/auth-guard.test.ts:11,17,24,31,38` cite "BR-001", "BR-002", "BR-016". These match **spec-AIT**
  wording (AIT BR-001 "available only to authenticated Tour Agencies", BR-002 "Guest … redirects to Login",
  BR-016 "A Matching Session is created…", `docs/spec/specs/spec-AIT.md:274,275,289`), not spec-AUT. Not a
  mislabel, but the file name `auth-guard` invites reading them as AUT BR-001/002/016, which say something
  different. Same for `tests/contract/sessions-api.test.ts:10,18` (AIT BR-016).
- `tests/prf/unit/agency-service.test.ts:72` cites "BR-017" = spec-PRF BR-017 (`spec-PRF.md:367`, Company
  Name / Tax ID → HDT review, account stays Approved): wording matches.

### (c) BR-012 five-minute revalidation
No five-minute timer, TTL or interval exists in `src/` (grep for `5 * 60`, `300000`, `revalidat`,
`setInterval`, "five minutes": only hit is `src/lib/booking/expire-holds.ts:46`, unrelated). Instead
`productSessionFromRequest` re-reads `account_status` and compares `role_context` with `role_code` on every
request (`src/lib/auth/product-session.ts:104-105`), reached from `sessionContextFromRequest`
(`src/lib/auth/session.ts:81`). This is stricter than "every five minutes" and matches AC-AUT-SESSION
("no 5-minute grace"). Session TTL is 12 h (`product-session.ts:8`). Spec BR-012 and AC-AUT-SESSION are
slightly in tension (BR-012 implies periodic checks; AC says immediate); a reviewer may want this noted.

### (d) HDT review of an Agency's major legal changes
Exists, end to end in code, partly tested:
- Submission (PRF): `src/lib/prf/agency-service.ts:100-110` — comment "BR-017 / FR-002: Company Name and Tax
  ID changes wait for HDT review; the approved values stay in effect, so they are stored as a Pending Review
  request instead of on the profile." Inserts `agency_major_change_requests` with `review_status: 'Pending
  Review'`; returns `requires_hdt_rereview` (`:134`).
- Agency UI: `src/app/agency/[agencyId]/edit/page.tsx:283` "Major legal changes trigger HDT re-review."; form
  sends `company_name`, `tax_id` (`:168-169`).
- HDT review: `src/lib/auth/agency-review.ts:18-21` lists changes (`kind: 'change'`); `:31-44` applies
  `proposed_company_name` / `proposed_tax_id` on Approve (duplicate Tax ID check `:38`), sets
  `review_status` Approved / Rejected / "Request More Information"; account status untouched.
  Route `src/app/api/auth/agency-reviews/route.ts:5-11`; page `src/app/admin/agencies/page.tsx` ("Đăng ký mới
  và thay đổi thông tin pháp lý được xử lý riêng. Dữ liệu đã duyệt vẫn có hiệu lực khi chờ thẩm định thay
  đổi."); nav link `src/app/components/SessionHeader.tsx:43` (HDT only, "Thẩm định công ty").
- Tests: AR:11 (approve applies new name, account status unchanged, stale second decision), AR:24
  (reject keeps approved name); `tests/prf/unit/agency-service.test.ts:72` (submission flags re-review,
  account Approved). AR tests insert the change row directly, so PRF submit → HDT approve is never tested
  as one flow, and no test goes through `/api/auth/agency-reviews`.
- Gaps to raise: Request More Information on a change sets `review_status = 'Request More Information'`
  (`agency-review.ts:43`) but issues no edit link and there is no Agency path to answer it; spec FR-018
  `major_change_review_status` enum is [Not Applicable, Pending Review, Approved, Rejected] (no RMI value),
